officialArchive.evidence: Bataleon's official archive lists Evil Twin and Evil Twin+ separately under 2024-25, and lists Evil Teen as a distinct model. It confirms adult model/season identity but does not expose the season's technical table.

backcountry2025.hostNote: Retailer product page; historical specs are secondary evidence, not a Bataleon-hosted catalog.
backcountry2025.evidence: 2025 product title and size variants; specs include 3BT with Sidekick, medium camber, true twin, flex 5/10, core/laminate/base/construction and per-size dimensions.

snowleader2025.hostNote: Retailer product page; used as independent retailer corroboration, not a Bataleon-hosted catalog.
snowleader2025.evidence: 2025 adult/Men model listing, season/model year, 157 reference-size details, geometry table, flex 5/10 and two-year warranty. The listed 2890 g weight is for reference size 157, not the seed's representative 154.

slashBoardShopRideReview.evidence: Reviewer states they rode the 2024/2025 board at Mt. Rose near the end of the 2024 season. Their report describes playful/forgiving presses and buttering, easy jib engagement, solid pop, smooth edge transitions, but loose nose/tail, washout on tail-heavy landings, and limits when driven hard at speed or in rough snow. They did not test it in powder. Their category ratings are Jibs 8/10, Jumps 8/10, Pow 6/10, Carving 5/10, Stability 5/10, Versatility 7/10; these are not mapped directly to this project's six editorial dimensions.
slashBoardShopRideReview.caveat: Single retailer-affiliated rider review, not a controlled or multi-rider test; reviewer did not state tested size.

snowboardingProfilesHistorical.disclosedSample: Bataleon Evil Twin 2024, 157 cm, tested 2023-03-29; 180 lb rider, US 9.5 boot, centered 560 mm stance. The page update date is not the test date and this sample predates the 2024/25 seed season.
snowboardingProfilesHistorical.conditions: Icy/hard groomers with softer patches, crunchy/icy off-groomer conditions, and no fresh snowfall during the test window.
snowboardingProfilesHistorical.observations: Easy turn initiation, slashy quick turns, catch-free feel, good press/butter, spins and small-to-medium jumps; unstable/wobbly at faster approaches, chatter and washout under aggressive carving, and limited support on bigger jumps/landings. No powder was tested; the reviewer's shallow/deep-powder comments are estimates from specs/feel, not direct snow testing.
snowboardingProfilesHistorical.scoreUse: Historical 2024-size-157 proxy only; not treated as a 24/25 retest and not numerically mapped into site scores.

product.core: Ultra Light Core: 70% paulownia / 30% poplar, with Central Super Tube carbon

seedMappingNotes: The seed remains on representative size 154. Snowleader reports 7.94 m; Backcountry rounds the same row to 8.0 m. The more precise retailer value is retained in the seed and both source-reported values are preserved here.

The retailer pages support centered stance/setback 0 and true twin. The official Bataleon archive confirms model/season only; it does not independently verify these dimensions or construction details.
Do not map the 157 reference-size 2890 g listing to the 154 seed weight. Existing 2720 g for size 154 has no matching source found and remains unverified.
Existing CNY 4899 has no same-market/source-date provenance found; it is not validated by the retailer's foreign-market listing and remains unchanged.
Current seed images are AI placeholders, not product photographs.

The same-season ride review provides directional evidence for response (smooth edge transitions, quick/easy ollies, and reviewer calls it responsive), reduced high-speed/rough-snow stability and catch-free press/butter forgiveness. It is a single retailer-affiliated rider account with no stated test size; powder was not tested. External category scores are not mechanically mapped.

Score calibration: stability changed 6→5.5 and response 6.5→7.5 based on that same-season ride account's explicit stability and response observations. These are restrained editorial adjustments, not conversions from its 5/10 stability rating. Float remains 7 without a powder test; park 8.5 and forgiveness 9 remain directionally consistent with Jibs/Jumps 8/10 and repeated press/butter observations; value 8 remains low-confidence because the seed CNY price lacks local provenance.
The seed's value score is especially uncertain because the CNY price has no verified market/source/date provenance.

Snowboarding Profiles' page now updated through 2026 still discloses a 2024 size-157 sample tested 2023-03-29. It adds only historical directional context: easier turns and catch-free playfulness, but weak high-speed/rough-snow limits and no powder test. Its 2840 g measured sample is not the 24/25 seed's 154 cm, so it does not verify the seed's 2720 g weight.

pricing.note: No suitable same-market CNY listing or clearly identified 2024-25 MSRP was verified; do not infer or replace seed price from current foreign-market retailer price.

excludedForeignListings.exclusionReason: Wrong width variant and market for the standard-width 154 Chinese-market seed; Russian pricing is not mapped or converted into the CNY seed value.

slashBoardShop.board: 2024/25 Bataleon Evil Twin; sample size not disclosed
slashBoardShop.testLocationAndTime: Mt. Rose, near the end of the 2024 season
slashBoardShop.directObservations: Smooth edge-to-edge transitions; quick/easy ollies; reviewer describes a responsive playful resort ride. Mid-flex, softer nose/tail and 3BT felt playful and forgiving for presses/butters; pop solid and jibs easy to lock in. Nose/tail felt loose: tail-heavy landings can wash out and hard-driving the nose/tail at speed or in rough snow reaches limits. Powder was not tested.
slashBoardShop.limitations: Single retailer-affiliated rider account; no board size, repeated days, or controlled comparison. External dimension scores are not linearly translated to site categories.

scoringEvidence.decision: Small stability/response adjustment only; retain all other scores. Float is unverified by an actual powder test, and value is especially provisional without local CNY price provenance.
scoringEvidence.confidence: Low-to-moderate overall because the sole matching-season report is one rider's account without a disclosed sample size or tested board length.
